one_line: The paper empirically applies an ISO 50001 energy management system to reduce energy use of pumping units at the Zai municipal water treatment plant in Jordan; desalination and a thermal power station appear only as peripheral mentions/references, and none of the eight Corpus-B continuous-flow sectors are involved.
